Legal by Anthropic

Selected capability · match your host

Claude web chatClaude Desktop ChatClaude CoworkClaude Code

Needs: Paid Claude plan · Organisation permission · Authorised files

  1. Open Customize > Plugins > Discover. Select Legal by Anthropic and choose Add; check organisation permissions.
  2. In a fresh chat use the / or + menu to find review-contract. Attach a small authorised file. Expect the workflow to appear before proceeding.

These are Claude menu steps. Choose the workflow in the / or + chat menu; it is not a terminal command. Availability depends on your plan and organisation.

App and setup boundaries

Chat runs skills/commands; hooks and sub-agents run in Cowork or Claude Code. Code account sync requires a supported current version. No connector is needed for the practice files.
